top_signals.title: Legendary logistics executive Klaus-Michael Kühne dead at 89
top_signals.summary:
Klaus-Michael Kühne, who took Kuehne+Nagel from a regional European company to a top global logistics provider, has died.

The post Legendary logistics executive Klaus-Michael Kühne dead at 89 appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Asia Buyers Snap Up American Crude, Add Stress to Tight Market
top_signals.summary: Asian refiners are on course to nearly double their purchases of US crude for September from a month earlier, a move that stands to squeeze domestic fuel makers at a time when Americans are already facing record high pump prices.
